title: A one-of whose alternatives do not bind the discriminator is rejected by the engine, not by the SDK.
why: behavioural spec 'one-of': the SDK does not check that the alternatives bind distinct discriminator literals, or bind one at all — the engine rejects both with 'interaction-invalid' when the interaction is added (shape spec §5.4), and a second check here could only disagree with it. So the case is that the DSL accepts the call and the failure arrives from the engine, carrying its own words.

interaction.description: a union whose alternatives bind no discriminator
